title: Harden BrowserWindow: sandbox, CSP, navigation and permission guards

acceptance_criteria: sandbox true; strict CSP; navigation and new windows denied; permission requests denied by default.

title: Restrict READ_FILE_BASE64 and CONFIG_IMPORT to dialog-approved paths
description: Handlers read any renderer-supplied path with fs.readFileSync. Where: src/main/ipc/config-handlers.ts (READ_FILE_BASE64, CONFIG_IMPORT filePath). Only allow paths previously returned by a native dialog (main-side approved set) with the expected extension.
acceptance_criteria: Reading a path not chosen via dialog is refused; test covers it.

title: Restrict local file read in RPC_TORRENT_ADD
description: If filename is an existing absolute path the file is read and sent to the remote daemon as metainfo. Where: src/main/ipc/rpc-handlers.ts (RPC_TORRENT_ADD). Same approved-path rule, .torrent only.
acceptance_criteria: Arbitrary local file cannot be exfiltrated via torrent-add.

title: Tests for the SSRF guard
description: Vitest cases: loopback, RFC1918, link-local, IPv6 ULA/loopback, metadata IP, DNS name resolving to private IP, opt-out env.
acceptance_criteria: All cases covered and green.

title: Encrypt and sign the active-server cookie
description: setActiveServerCookie stores host/username/password as plain base64 JSON; COOKIE_SECRET has a hardcoded fallback and is never used. Where: apps/web/src/lib/server-actions/session.ts. Use iron-session (already a dependency); fail to start in production without COOKIE_SECRET.
acceptance_criteria: Cookie is unreadable and tamper-proof without the secret; no fallback secret in code; test covers tampering.

title: SSRF guard on server actions
description: rpcRequest and testServerConnection POST to any host/port supplied by the caller or cookie. Where: apps/web/src/lib/server-actions/rpc.ts. Default-deny loopback, private, link-local and cloud-metadata ranges after DNS resolution (anti-rebinding), with env opt-out SEEDORA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS=true for LAN self-hosting. Design choice documented in SECURITY.md.
acceptance_criteria: Requests to 127.0.0.1, 10.x, 192.168.x, 169.254.169.254 and rebinding hosts are refused by default and allowed with the opt-out.

title: Security hardening — Electron
description: Electron window lacks sandbox/CSP/navigation guards; IPC handlers accept arbitrary paths and unvalidated arguments; credentials stored in plain JSON.
acceptance_criteria: All Electron security issues in this epic closed; IPC validated; credentials encrypted at rest.

title: Security hardening — web
description: apps/web server actions allow SSRF and store Transmission credentials in an unsigned base64 cookie; no security headers.
acceptance_criteria: All web security issues in this epic closed and covered by tests; SECURITY.md documents the model.

title: Triage npm audit: 64 advisories (2 critical, 47 high)
description: npm ci on origin/staging (2026-11-15) reports 64 advisories. Acceptance: each advisory classified as production-reachable or build-toolchain only; reachable ones fixed or filed individually at P0/P1; remaining handled by the dependency upgrade issue; result recorded in MEMORY.md.

title: Translate the 49 keys missing from 21 locales

title: Bencode parser hangs on truncated .torrent

acceptance_criteria: Malformed input throws a typed error; regression tests with truncated fixtures.

title: Editing the active server does not take effect until restart

acceptance_criteria: Edits to host/credentials apply immediately on both platforms.

title: RPC client: timeout, proxy race, self-signed TLS option
description: No request timeout; proxy agent created asynchronously so early requests bypass the proxy; self-signed certificates always fail. Where: src/main/rpc/client.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Requests time out; first request uses the proxy; per-server opt-in to accept a self-signed certificate.

title: Validate all IPC handler arguments and sender frame
description: No handler validates arguments or checks event.senderFrame. Where: src/main/ipc/config-handlers.ts, rpc-handlers.ts, handlers.ts, src/main/index.ts. Add zod schemas and a sender check helper; SERVER_UPDATE/PREFS_SET must reject unknown keys; GEOIP_LOOKUP bounded.
acceptance_criteria: Every handler validates input; malformed calls return an error without side effects.

title: Tracked .claude/settings.json with permissions and hook

description: Zero aria/role attributes, dialogs without focus management, web app not responsive, colours bypass design tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard-only use works end to end; Lighthouse a11y >= 95 on web; UI verified visually in light and dark.

description: Peer list is not virtualised. Where: packages/shared/src/components/details/PeersTab.tsx.

title: Design polish: hierarchy, spacing, empty/loading/error states

title: Split FilesTab.tsx (509 LOC)
description: Only file over 500 LOC. Where: packages/shared/src/components/details/FilesTab.tsx.

acceptance_criteria: One locale registry shared by both apps.
